name: coop-builder
description: Low-poly 3D co-op building game powered by SpacetimeDB

scripts.stdb:generate: node scripts/spacetime.mjs generate --lang typescript --out-dir src/module_bindings --module-path spacetimedb
scripts.stdb:publish:local: node scripts/spacetime.mjs publish coop-builder --module-path spacetimedb --server local --yes
scripts.stdb:publish: node scripts/spacetime.mjs publish coop-builder-mhacks --module-path spacetimedb --server maincloud --yes
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:sync
